summary: @servicetitan/design-system 14.5.8: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from GitHub releases and then executes a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped inside the tarball via `execFileSync(<bun>, ['math_init.js'], {cwd:D})`. `setup.mjs` is identifier-obfuscated (`_0xXXXX` names, string-map indirection). `math_init.js` is a 727KB `@bun @bun-cjs` compiled bundle with a shuffled hex-code string array, an array-rotation function, and a decoder — the classic obfuscated-string-array shape. `math_init.js` is not listed in `package.json.files` but ships in the tarball, hiding it from typical file-listing review. The package presents itself as a React/CSS design system (matching the legitimate ServiceTitan Anvil design system's README, homepage, and dist/ layout), and that declared purpose has no legitimate need for an alternate JS runtime or an opaque compiled payload at install time. The preinstall fires automatically on `npm install`, so any installer of this version executes the obfuscated Bun payload on their host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
